title: CDP Configuration
description: Configure and verify Cisco Discovery Protocol for neighbor discovery.
scenario: Configure and verify Cisco Discovery Protocol for neighbor discovery.

concepts.title: What is CDP?
concepts.body: CDP (Cisco Discovery Protocol) is Cisco-proprietary. It discovers directly connected devices and their platform.
concepts.code:
SW1# show cdp neighbors
SW2 Gig 0/1 WS-C2960 Gig 0/1

concepts.title: Enable / Disable CDP
concepts.body: CDP is on by default. "cdp run" enables globally; "no cdp enable" disable it per-interface.
concepts.code:
SW1(config)# cdp run
SW1(config)# interface
SW1(config-if)# no cdp enable

concepts.title: Security
concepts.body: Disable CDP/LLDP on ports facing untrusted networks to prevent information leaking
concepts.code: no cdp enable → hides from foreign networks
